On Banning Junk Guns in California — to Governor Wilson, 5 June 1997
Guns,Gun violence,Gun control,Governor of California,University of California Davis

Governor Pete Wilson
State Capitol Building
Sacramento, CA 95814
June 5, 1997
Dear Governor Wilson:
I am writing to urge you to sign legislation to prohibit the sale and manufacture of junk guns in California. As you are aware, such legislation has passed both houses of the California legislature and is expected to reach your desk shortly.
